event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: ESP 4666 was represented by Cristian Fornes (skipper)
ESP 10371 was represented by Richard Zabell Lucase (tactician)
Joan Cirerol (crew member of ESP 8835)gave evidence as a witness for ESP 4666.
Francesco Teprasa (tactician of ESP 74441) gave evidence as a witness for ESP 4666.
The panel of the International Jury presented tracking evidence of the incident.
facts: ESP 4666 is 32 feet long and ESP 10371 is 38 feet long
The conditions at the time of the incident on the first downwind of race 3 for ORC C were 8 knots of wind and small chop.
ESP 4666 was sailing downwind on starboard tack and was approaching the gate mark that was to be left to port.
ESP 10371 was approaching the same mark on port tack and was sailing to windward of ESP 4666 and on a converging course with her.
When entering the zone of the gate mark, ESP 10371 was overlapped outside of ESP 4666 at a lateral distance of 25 m from bow to bow.
ESP 10371 was sailing faster, passed 10m in front of ESP 4666 and rounded the gate mark clear ahead of ESP 4666 at a lateral distance of 10 m to the mark.
ESP 4666 gybed to port tack and rounded the mark 10 m clear astern of ESP 10371 at a lateral distance of 1 m to the mark
conclusions: ESP 10371 outside overlapped at the zone gave ESP 4666 mark-room, as required by RRS 18.2(a)(1).
ESP 10371 on port tack kept clear of ESP 4666 on starboard tack, as required by RRS 10.
